description: Free. Returns every agentdatafeed dataset with record count, last update, price per query, filters and links. Call it first to choose a dataset, then use get_sample to inspect records or query_dataset for filtered data. When to use each dataset: amsterdam-events: Use when a user asks what is on in Amsterdam on a date or in a district, plans travel, venues, staffing, security or deliveries around large events, or needs crowd sizes, road closures context or permit status before the event appears on ticket sites. security-advisories: Use when a user asks whether a CVE is actively exploited, which vulnerabilities in a vendor or product to patch first, whether it is used in ransomware campaigns, or needs CISA KEV due dates, required actions and FIRST EPSS exploit probability in one call. vulnerability-watch: Use when a user asks which recent vulnerabilities affect a server product or version, wants new critical CVEs (for example CVSS 9 or higher) for a vendor this week, or needs CVSS, affected version ranges and exploit signals (KEV, EPSS) for a CVE in the news. eu-tenders: Use when a user asks which public tenders or government contracts are open in an EU country or sector, wants bid opportunities by CPV code or keyword with a deadline, or needs to monitor what public buyers are procuring before the deadline passes. uk-tenders: Use when a user asks which UK government or public sector contracts are open to bid, wants UK tender opportunities by sector, CPV code, keyword, region or buyer with the deadline and value, or needs Find a Tender and Contracts Finder notices in one search, for example SME-friendly IT tenders in Scotland closing this month. eu-funding: Use when a user asks which EU grants, subsidies or Horizon Europe calls are open or coming up for a topic, sector or organisation type, needs the deadline, budget and call link for an EU funding opportunity, or looks for small cascade funding calls for SMEs and start-ups. cert-advisories: Use when a user asks whether the Dutch, German or French national CERT or CERT-EU has warned about a CVE, vendor or product, needs the official European advisory ID and link for a patch or NIS2 report, or wants recent government advisories that cover known exploited (CISA KEV) vulnerabilities. eu-medicines: Use when a user asks whether a medicine or active substance is authorised in the EU, who holds the marketing authorisation, what it is indicated for, whether there is a current EMA-monitored shortage, or which safety communications and referral procedures concern it. sanctions-entities: Use when a user or a KYC, AML, procurement or shipping workflow needs to check whether a company, organisation, vessel or aircraft is on the EU or OFAC sanctions list, find the programme and legal basis of a listing, or look up a sanctioned vessel by IMO number; not for screening individual people. product-recalls: Use when a user, shop, marketplace, procurement or compliance workflow asks whether a product, food, medicine, medical device, vehicle, tyre or child car seat has been recalled or flagged as unsafe in the US (FDA, CPSC, NHTSA), Canada or the UK, which allergen or hazard caused it, how serious the recall class is, whether a recalled car should not be driven, or which recalls concern a given brand, firm or vehicle make. eu-legislation: Use when a user, compliance, legal or policy workflow asks which EU regulations, directives or decisions were recently published or amended on a topic, whether an act is in force and from when, which acts amend or repeal a given CELEX number, or needs the CELEX, ELI or OJ reference and the official EUR-Lex link of an EU act. drug-shortages: Use when a user, pharmacist, hospital, wholesaler or procurement workflow asks whether a medicine or active substance is currently in short supply in the US or the EU, why, since when, when supply is expected back, which manufacturers or strengths are affected, or whether alternatives are available. public-holidays: Use when a user, scheduler, payroll, logistics or booking workflow needs to know whether a date is an official public or bank holiday in one of the covered countries or regions, which holidays fall in a date range, or how to count business days around holidays this year or next year.
